name: api
description: HTTP service: transport, domain, storage and contracts in separate layers.

starters.internal/domain/README.md:
# Domain

Rules and types that do not depend on HTTP, storage or the platform. Import only the standard library and this folder.
starters.internal/store/README.md:
# Data owner

Every persisted record has one owner here. Migrations live beside the schema.
starters.internal/api/README.md:
# Transport

HTTP handlers translate requests into domain calls. No business rules here.
starters.cmd/README.md:
# Entry point

Wiring only: configuration, adapters and the server lifecycle.

name: web
description: Browser application: components, pages, core primitives, styles from tokens.

starters.src/core/README.md:
# Shared primitives

Small, dependency-free helpers used by every feature. No imports from components or pages.
starters.src/components/README.md:
# UI components

Reusable presentational components. A component receives data and emits events; it does not fetch.
starters.src/pages/README.md:
# Pages

One file per page, composing components and core primitives.
starters.src/data/README.md:
# Data

Tables and typed fixtures. Behaviour data lives here, not in conditionals.
starters.ui/tokens/README.md:
# Design tokens

The only source of colours and sizes; generate the CSS from these files.

name: cli
description: Command-line tool: command dispatch, one file per command, shared core.

starters.internal/commands/README.md:
# Commands

One file per command: parse arguments, call the core, print the result.
starters.internal/core/README.md:
# Core

Shared logic with no terminal or file-system side effects.

name: interactive
description: Interactive application: engine, state, input, rendering, assets and tests separated.

starters.src/state/README.md:
# State owner

The single owner of mutable state; systems read and mutate it through declared operations.
starters.src/engine/README.md:
# Engine

Simulation and update loop. No rendering or input handling here.
starters.src/render/README.md:
# Rendering

Reads state and draws it; never mutates state.
